consequence.statement: Environments that get cert-manager from OperatorHub (RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub or operatorhub.io) get no cert-manager releases newer than v1.16.5 from that source. The evidence doesn't say that existing installs fail.
consequence.remediation: If you need cert-manager releases newer than v1.16.5, plan a move to a distribution method other than OperatorHub.

assertion.statement: OperatorHub Packages Discontinued: We no longer publish OperatorHub packages for cert-manager

evidence.excerpt:
### OperatorHub Packages Discontinued

We no longer publish OperatorHub packages for cert-manager.
Why? Because the cert-manager maintainers no longer have the time or resources to maintain and test those packages.
cert-manager `v1.16.5` is the last release on OperatorHub.

> ℹ️ [cert-manager `v1.16.5` for RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub](https://github.com/redhat-openshift-ecosystem/community-operators-prod/tree/main/operators/cert-manager/1.16.5).
>
> ℹ️ [cert-manager `v1.16.5` for `operatorhub.io`](https://github.com/k8s-operatorhub/community-operators/tree/main/operators/cert-manager/…
